summary_md: **Nate Vick ([@nate_vick](https://x.com/nate_vick/status/2116173042506461643))** urges enforcing agent rules with code, sharing his **harness** with a done-means gate blocking edits until a spec exists and requiring changed tests to fail when the fix is reverted, CI guards for copied code and empty catches, and a Cursor cloud-agent adapter ([natevick/harness](https://github.com/natevick/harness)).
relevance: Code-enforced guardrails rather than prompt suggestions.
